axis: membership not yet complete → belonging claimed as kinship or honour

members.tone: Turns fellow membership of a sorority, a union or any other group into a family tie between women, warmer than the bare enrolment *member* records.
The male counterpart of *sister*, claiming a kinship that a fraternity, a religion or any other group is taken to supply.
Membership as conferred standing — a learned society's name for one of its own, where *member* would only note that someone belongs.
The flat term for one of the people a group is composed of, joining and taking part included but no warmth or rank added.
Names a person by an admission still unfinished, accepted but held short of the settled standing *member* assumes.
